Hi folks -

I have a conditional panel that I want to display in my app to let the user know the app is 'busy' and not stuck.  The way I am going about it works locally by running
the app from RStudio but does NOT work when I run it on my Linux shiny server.  I know my animated gif is in the right place, and I am not receiving nay errors in the log file.

Here is the relevant code snippet:

     tabPanel("Plot",  
              div(id="plot"),
              conditionalPanel(condition="$('html').hasClass('shiny-busy')", img(src="dogfetcher2.gif"), h5("fetching plot data...") ),
              conditionalPanel(condition="!($('html').hasClass('shiny-busy'))", br()),
                            
              helpText("Map of input polygons by strata"),
              plotOutput(outputId = "plot"),
              value=2
      ),

Why does this work locally and not on the server?
